{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate: keep only the row with the highest sample_seq per patient_id
data_dedup = data.loc[data.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Now compute the fraction of patients with severe baseline disease
severe_count = data_dedup['severity'].eq('severe').sum()
total_patients = len(data_dedup)
fraction_severe = severe_count / total_patients

print(f'Severe count: {severe_count}')
print(f'Total patients after deduplication: {total_patients}')
print(f'Fraction with severe baseline disease: {fraction_severe}')"}
